business_problem: MAX Burgers' previous lakehouse platform was too inflexible and expensive to operate, making data-model changes slow, increasing staffing pressure, and limiting how safely business users and partners could explore shared data.
solution_summary: MAX Burgers migrated both its data warehouse and then its data lake to Snowflake so marketing, HR, business control, data science, and external partners could work from a simpler analytics backbone. Data from business sources lands in Snowflake, where the same platform supports raw data-lake access for data scientists under GDPR rules and curated warehouse models for business users. The migration moved the warehouse in two weeks and the lake in a couple of months, while dramatically reducing model-change effort, so extensions that once took up to eight hours can now be developed, tested, and deployed in about half an hour. Zero-Copy Cloning lets developers clone a roughly 7 TB production database in about ten seconds for safe experimentation, and data-sharing accounts simplify controlled access for external partners. This lower engineering overhead and broader self-service access lets MAX focus its small team on new features and business value rather than platform management.

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Hosts MAX Burgers' centralized data warehouse and data lake workloads for business analytics and governed data science access.

solution_components.name: Zero-Copy Cloning
solution_components.role: Creates near-instant safe copies of production data so developers can experiment without risking live workloads.

data_flow: Operational data from multiple business sources is ingested into Snowflake, where MAX maintains both raw data-lake access for data scientists and transformed warehouse models for business users. Developers use Zero-Copy Cloning to test against production-like data safely, and curated outputs are shared internally and with selected external partners.
business_outcome: MAX reduced model-change effort from up to eight hours to about half an hour, gave users safer self-service access to data, simplified external sharing, and created a platform that can scale to many more users without extra engineering overhead.
architecture_clues: MAX runs both warehouse and data-lake workloads on Snowflake so business users and data scientists work from the same governed platform.

Snowflake data-sharing accounts are used to expose only the data external partners need.

The company ingests data from a variety of sources into Snowflake for its data lake workload, where data scientists can access the information in line with strict GDPR regulations.
If someone is looking at our fact table, and they want to see something specific, we can develop, test and deploy a new dimension in about half an hour.
